A few reminders about route planning
It is for pet owners
Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk

Route Planning Notice

Travelers should review pet travel plans before they arrive at the airport so there is time to check crate fit, route limits, and the needs of the animal. Clear guidance is available before departure, and the desk can help with common concerns in a calm and practical way.

For bird travel, please note the carrier rules that apply to the pet and crate together. <<FACT F065>> Keep documents ready, make sure the crate is secure, and use simple bedding that keeps the animal comfortable without adding clutter.

For reptile travel, the crate must meet the size rule for the longest side. <<FACT F072>> If you are unsure about the container you have chosen, the desk can review it and explain whether a different option is needed. Supervisors listen carefully when a passenger is worried, and they will help you prepare with care.

Please bring any questions to the Companion Animal Travel Desk before check-in.
